candidate_063.name: held-out-gated typed claim store plus periodic second-order meta-reflection
candidate_063.mechanism_hypothesis: Persist both accepted and rejected hypothesis outcomes with explicit status, then periodically reason over the typed claim store to identify search gaps, confounds, contradictions, variable clusters and compound hypotheses. Only statistically held-out-validated claims enter the accepted store; rejected outcomes remain process evidence rather than active facts. Use reflection to redirect future proposal distribution without treating the reflection text itself as scientific evidence.

primary_evidence.source: DiscoPER: Autonomous Scientific Discovery via Iterative Meta-Reflection, arXiv:2607.01131v1
primary_evidence.design: Open-ended PROPOSE-EVALUATE-REFLECT discovery over real iNaturalist data. Each experiment runs 100 iterations with REFLECT every five iterations and three experimental repetitions. A hypothesis is accepted only if |effect size| >= 0.2 and p <= 0.05 on both train and held-out validation, plus |delta_val| >= 0.6*|delta_train|. The no-REFLECT ablation keeps the same open-ended prompt, backbone, statistical tools, held-out validation, planner and evaluator, setting only reflection guidance to empty.
primary_evidence.interpretation: This is unusually direct science-domain evidence that periodic meta-analysis of accumulated accepted/rejected outcomes can improve the breadth and support of subsequent open-ended discovery when proposal, tools, evaluator and validation are held fixed. It strengthens the typed-memory line: rejected attempts can productively guide search if their rejected status is preserved, instead of being forgotten or reintroduced as facts.
primary_evidence.limits: The claim store has no explicit stale-memory revocation lifecycle or formal contradiction-key semantics. REFLECT guidance is generated text and is not itself held-out validated. iNaturalist is observational and recall uses an LLM semantic judge; support thresholds can be gamed, so the paper pairs support with literature-pattern recall. The four-backbone sensitivity analysis is small and does not isolate reflection on every backbone.

candidate_063.relation_to_existing: Strengthens candidate_054/058/061: strategic memory should be status-typed and reflect over both successes and failures, while candidate_061-style revocation remains a separate missing lifecycle mechanism.

semantic_progress.status: New science-domain matched component candidate with three-repeat no-REFLECT ablation.

candidate_064.name: explicit epistemic discovery state as an active control interface
candidate_064.mechanism_hypothesis: Externalize a bounded investigation state containing pattern priorities, main/alternative/artifact/robustness hypotheses, executable query bundles, evidence references, per-hypothesis status, red flags, unresolved concerns, resolution confidence, remaining budget and frontier saturation. Let local adjudication update what is supportable, then let frontier control choose create/deepen/switch/retire/stop from the updated epistemic state. Treat the state as a control interface, not passive context memory.

primary_evidence.source: StatefulDiscovery: Evidence-Calibrated Claim Formation in Open-Ended Scientific Discovery, arXiv:2606.11851v1
primary_evidence.design: 40 real-data open-ended discovery tasks from BixBench, BLADE and DiscoveryBench with no target answer/research question, fixed 40 code-execution budget and a common Qwen3.5-plus backbone for main methods. Cumulative ablation adds pattern state, structured hypothesis sets, L2 evidence adjudication, then L1 frontier control.
primary_evidence.interpretation: Structured alternatives/artifact/robustness checks increase discovery value but initially reduce evidential support; local adjudication filters unresolved claims; frontier control then restores useful yield without abandoning the adjudication layer. This supports an architecture where epistemic status changes both promotion and the allocation of the next research budget unit, instead of being a post-hoc report annotation.
primary_evidence.limits: The ablation is explicitly cumulative and sequentially dependent, so row differences do not isolate independent causal effects of every component. ES/DV are LLM-judged, although a 120-claim human study reports strong rank agreement. Tasks are tabular/code analyses with literature access removed, not end-to-end laboratory science, and confidence is heuristic rather than probabilistically calibrated.

candidate_064.relation_to_existing: Provides a concrete science-domain realization of candidate_027/058-style issue state and candidate_044-style bounded task contracts, but with direct frontier allocation driven by evidence status. It complements candidate_063: DiscoPER meta-reflects over a claim store; StatefulDiscovery uses explicit local epistemic status to drive both claim formation and frontier actions.

status: New mechanism candidate with 40-task same-backbone cumulative ablation and explicit process state.

evidence_scope_correction.source: AI scientists produce results without reasoning scientifically, arXiv:2604.18805v1
evidence_scope_correction.interpretation: Strong negative boundary evidence: process scaffolds and memory/control candidates should not be treated as substitutes for model-level epistemic capability. Explicit gates can constrain promotion and route evidence, but underlying scientific reasoning remains a major bottleneck and should itself become an optimization/training target.
evidence_scope_correction.limits: The paper evaluates the studied scaffolds and environments, not every possible external verifier/control architecture; the result does not falsify machine-checkable gates or targeted matched components that show local causal benefit.

parallel_frontier_search.matched_mandatory_science_repair: Still open. StatefulDiscovery and DiscoPER provide evidence-driven control and matched reflection evidence, but neither directly randomizes optional critique versus mandatory evidence-changing repair/downgrade/block under identical budget.
parallel_frontier_search.fresh_root_restart: Still open in autonomous science; no matched full fresh-root restart versus continued repair was found in this run.
parallel_frontier_search.memory_frontier: DiscoPER supplies same-components science evidence for typed accepted/rejected outcome memory plus meta-reflection; StatefulDiscovery supplies explicit epistemic state driving claim status and frontier allocation. Highest-value next test is to combine these with explicit stale-state revocation/bounded active retrieval and evaluate multi-seed/multi-backbone science performance.
